newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korea's Yukong extends reformer closure to Feb 9.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong extends reformer closure to Feb 9.

text.p: South Korean Yukong Ltd has extended its shutdown of its 60,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) reformer production until February 9, an industry source said on Monday.
The company's 10,000-bpd No.1 and 15,000-bpd No.2 reformers were shut on January 24 due to bad margins.
The shutdown duration was initially only 10-15 days and the units were expected to resume output this week.
"It has been extended to after the Lunar New year holidays," the source said. "After that, the situation will be checked."
He said currently reforming margins were still poor.
